title.zh: Payments Giant Fiserv Launches Digital Asset Platform, With Bank of North Dakota
title.en: Payments Giant Fiserv Launches Digital Asset Platform, With Bank of North Dakota

current_state.zh: Fiserv's digital asset platform is now live with financial institution clients, debuting with Bank of North Dakota's USD-backed Roughrider Coin stablecoin issued by VersaBank on Solana with Fireblocks infrastructure, targeting access for more than 90 banks and credit unions through Fiserv's Commercial Center.
current_state.en: Fiserv's digital asset platform is now live with financial institution clients, debuting with Bank of North Dakota's USD-backed Roughrider Coin stablecoin issued by VersaBank on Solana with Fireblocks infrastructure, targeting access for more than 90 banks and credit unions through Fiserv's Commercial Center.

updates.title_zh: 支付巨头 Fiserv 推出数字资产平台，携手北达科他州银行
updates.title_en: Payments Giant Fiserv Launches Digital Asset Platform, With Bank of North Dakota
updates.what_changed_zh:
Fiserv 的数字资产平台已面向金融机构客户上线，首个落地用例是北达科他州银行（BND）推出的美元支持稳定币 Roughrider Coin，由 VersaBank USA 发行，Fireblocks 提供代币化基础设施，Solana 处理交易。预计北达科他州超过 90 家银行和信用合作社将通过 Fiserv 已有的银行间转账系统 Commercial Center 接入。

BND 表示，该代币的发起、审批和结算都走银行处理 ACH 和电汇时所用的同一套操作通道，这为参与的北达科他州机构在公共区块链上增加了一条具备许可访问控制的银行间结算路径。

参与为自愿性质且仅限金融机构；BND 称每枚代币与美元一比一锚定，只有在机构运营账户向指定「for benefit of」账户完成转账后才会铸造，代币到达收款机构钱包时会通过智能合约指令自动销毁。Fiserv 将铸造、销毁、托管和储备管理职责交给 VersaBank USA，BND 提到可通过 Solana 的 Token-2022 扩展实现冻结和追回功能；Fiserv 称 Roughrider 为稳定币，而 BND 的部署页面称其为「美元支持的代币存款」，双方均未披露支付规模。
updates.what_changed_en: Fiserv's digital asset platform is now live with financial institution clients, debuting with Bank of North Dakota's USD-backed Roughrider Coin stablecoin issued by VersaBank on Solana with Fireblocks infrastructure, targeting access for more than 90 banks and credit unions through Fiserv's Commercial Center.

updates.background_zh: 北达科他州银行是一家州属银行，与作为其核心银行服务提供商的 Fiserv 合作开发该州自己的稳定币。此次正式上线之前，BND 与 Fiserv 曾发布公告，计划在 2026 年提供相关服务。Fireblocks 是数字资产与稳定币基础设施提供商，Solana 是公共区块链，该代币在其上以许可资产形式部署。
updates.background_en: The Bank of North Dakota is a state-owned bank that has partnered with Fiserv, its core banking services provider, to develop the state's own stablecoin. The production milestone follows an earlier BND and Fiserv announcement that planned availability in 2026. Fireblocks is a digital asset and stablecoin infrastructure provider, and Solana is a public blockchain on which the token is deployed as a permissioned asset.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道是银行结算基础设施：一家州特许银行的美元支持代币经由 Solana 和 Fireblocks 托管运行，在现有的 ACH 与电汇之外增加了一条机构级代币化存款通道，可能提升 Solana 上的链上交易活动，并扩大银行发行稳定币相对现有稳定币结算网络的可及市场。风险敞口主要集中在稳定币与银行支付基础设施，而非某一可交易资产。
updates.market_impact_en: The channel is bank settlement infrastructure: a state-chartered bank's dollar-backed token routed over Solana with Fireblocks custody adds an institutional tokenized-deposit rail that sits alongside existing ACH and wire transfers, potentially expanding on-chain transaction activity on Solana and the addressable market for bank-issued stablecoins versus existing stablecoin settlement networks. Exposure is concentrated in stablecoin and bank-payments infrastructure rather than in any single tradable asset.
